# Clicking a table header filter also sorts its column

## Context

I found this while reviewing `#19788`, the grid fix for `#19787`, whose ticket scopes Table behavior out. I reproduced it live on `dev` `5829f5d407` in `examples/tableFiltering`.

## The Problem

In the table filtering example, a click into the Firstname header filter's empty input focuses it and also sorts the column ascending. The rows reorder from Tobias, Rich, Nils, Gerard to Bastian, Durlabh, Gerard, Hyle, and the header gains `neo-sort-asc`. No text was entered. A user who only wants to place the caret reorders the table.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/table/header/Button.mjs:191` pushes the filter field into the header button's own vdom, so clicks on the field reach the header's `onClick` (`:378`).
- That `onClick` has no exclusion at all; it always advances the sort state. The grid header's `onClick` already skips the menu trigger and the resize handle (`src/grid/header/Button.mjs:406–410`), and `#19788` adds the filter field to that list.
- Design authority: `learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md` defines header filters as "allowing users to filter data directly from the column headers", and its Sorting section makes a header click the sorting gesture (quoted in `#19787`). The grid header inherited this field from the table (`#6169`). `Tables.md` and the table header's JSDoc say nothing about either (searched).

## The Fix

Mirror `#19788` in `src/table/header/Button.mjs` `onClick`: return early when the click path contains the filter field's root (`filterField.id`). The input and its nested controls then never sort, while caption clicks still do. Add a Table arm to `test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderInlineProjectionNL.spec.mjs`, which already carries Table cases.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Clicking an empty or populated table header filter leaves the header's sort state and the Store's sorters unchanged.
- [ ] Nested filter controls (the clear trigger, the numeric operator) filter without sorting.
- [ ] A click on the table header caption still sorts and toggles direction.
- [ ] The Table arm fails on the current source and passes with the repair.

## Out of Scope

The grid header (`#19788`), the header-filter layout (OQ8 in `#19786`), and the record-search toolbar.
